_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::low_mach#2 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The rule (use MAT_sutherland, not MAT_fluid) holds. The quoted abort 'material MAT_fluid incompatible with PHYSICAL_TYPE Loma' does not exist, and neither does the alternative outcome the entry offered ('results show constant density'). On the upstream deck loma_2d_heated_chan_30x100 the scalar-transport discretisation is cloned from the fluid one, so the material is checked by ScatraFluidCloneStrategy and the run dies with 'Material with ID 1 is not admissible for scalar transport elements' from 4C_scatra_utils_clonestrategy.cpp, before any time step. The message names neither the material type nor Loma, so grepping the log for either learns nothing. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: Material with ID 1 is not admissible for scalar transport elements
